required_floor_classes.lane_definition: An agriculture scenario cannot pass if farm-program access, crop-insurance access, research/service access, conservation access, rural producer access, or small/underserved producer access falls below reviewed floors.
An agriculture scenario cannot pass if lower costs degrade farm resilience, risk protection, food-system resilience, research quality, animal/plant health, conservation quality, or program integrity.

An agriculture scenario cannot pass if support, risk, compliance burden, conservation burden, market exposure, or access shifts by farm size, crop, region, income, race/ethnicity, tribal status, or beginning-farmer status without review.

An agriculture scenario cannot pass if risk management, disaster/crop loss resilience, productivity, research adoption, rural resilience, or conservation/environmental resilience falls below reviewed floors.

An agriculture scenario cannot pass without FY2025 function-350 account crosswalk, separate budget-support/insurance/services/market-price-support treatment, farm/acre/production/risk denominators, implementation cost, payment-integrity lineage, and nutrition handoff without double counting.

agriculture_specific_floor_definitions.definition: Farm resilience, income stabilization, risk protection, and disaster/crop loss outcomes require sourced baseline, policy, and stress values before any lower-cost scenario can pass.
Crop-insurance payment-integrity facts require same-cohort debt, appeal, collection, prevention, control-cost, and account-crosswalk lineage before any recoverable savings credit.
Agricultural research, extension, inspection, animal/plant health, adoption, and productivity outcomes require reviewed floors.
Conservation, soil, water, habitat, climate, and environmental crossover outcomes require component-specific floors and cannot be blended with science/energy/environment targets.
Food and nutrition assistance belongs to income security and requires an explicit handoff to avoid double counting in agriculture.

No target cost can be selected without separate budget support, insurance, general services, market-price support, FY2025 account crosswalk, farm/acre/production/risk denominators, implementation cost, and delivery feasibility.

public_warning_phrases: This agriculture floor packet defines required floor concepts, but it does not set threshold values or pass/fail findings.
Food and nutrition assistance is function 600 income security, not function 350 agriculture; combining it here would double count another lane.
The crop-insurance payment-integrity bridge is not a FY2025 function-350 account crosswalk, fraud finding, collectible-debt measure, or savings estimate.

No lower-cost agriculture scenario is admissible until farm resilience, payment-integrity boundary, research/services/productivity, conservation/environmental crossover, nutrition handoff, component-account-denominator, equity, adequacy/resilience, and delivery-feasibility floors are thresholded, sourced, reviewed, and passed.
No target cost, federal effect, gross savings, net savings, solver input, department-cut instruction, technology-savings claim, or balanced-budget claim is populated.
No FOIA request, records request, form, email, phone call, or agency/person contact was submitted.

This record is not outcome-floor passage, not a budget-support path, not an insurance path, not a general-services path, not a market-price-support path, not a FY2025 account crosswalk, not a federal score, not a target-cost selection, not solver input, not a rate calculation, not a public rate card, not a savings estimate, not a waste finding, not a fraud finding, not a department-cut instruction, not a technology-savings claim, and not a balanced-budget claim.
